description: Refinery Digital Twin — entity type definitions. Each type has a description, a list of static properties (set once in refinery_instance.json), and a list of allowed relationship types. Dynamic properties (live values per snapshot) are discoverable via tag_mapping.json (filter where entity_id == X). The 9 first-class types plus the nested Stage type cover all 23 Phase 0a sim objects plus the 3 ontology aggregator entities (Refinery + 2 Subsystems).

relationships.CONTAINS: Aggregation: parent entity contains child (Refinery contains Subsystems; Subsystems contain unit ops and streams).
relationships.RECEIVES_FEED_FROM: Column receives a material feed stream (column-specific).
relationships.PRODUCES: Column or equipment emits a product stream.
relationships.CONSUMES_DUTY: Unit op consumes energy (heat in) — points to an EnergyStream.
relationships.REJECTS_DUTY: Unit op rejects energy (heat out) — points to an EnergyStream.
relationships.FROM: Stream's source unit op (every MaterialStream / EnergyStream has at most one FROM).
relationships.TO: Stream's destination unit op (every MaterialStream / EnergyStream has at most one TO).
relationships.RECEIVES_FROM: Equipment receives material from an upstream MaterialStream.
relationships.DISCHARGES_TO: Equipment discharges material to a downstream MaterialStream.
relationships.CLOSES_LOOP: Recycle block annotates a closed loop's tear stream (input side).
relationships.REOPENS_LOOP: Recycle block's output side — same physical stream as CLOSES_LOOP target after convergence.
relationships.LHS: Constraint left-hand side reference (computed from RHS via the rule).
relationships.RHS: Constraint right-hand side reference (independent variable in the constraint).
relationships.CONSTRAINED_BY: Reverse pointer: an entity is the target of one or more Constraint entities.

Refinery.description: Top-level container — the entire flowsheet. Ontology aggregator, no DWSIM counterpart.

Subsystem.description: Logical grouping by property package. PetroleumSide (Peng-Robinson) and ThermalOilLoop (CoolProp Incompressible). Ontology aggregator, no DWSIM counterpart.

Column.description: Distillation column with multiple theoretical stages. Stage 0 = condenser, Stage NumberOfStages-1 = reboiler, intermediate stages are internal trays.

Stage.description: Single theoretical stage inside a Column. Nested under the Column entity (NOT a first-class entity in refinery_instance.json's `entities` dict). Stage tags (COL-X.STAGE_N.<prop>) map to `stages[N].<prop>` in tag_mapping.json.

Heater.description: Heat exchanger or proxy heater. In this substrate: 'Thermal Oil Heating' (external utility input) and 'Reboiler (Proxy)' (handoff to the column reboiler).

Pump.description: Centrifugal pump moving liquid. In this substrate: thermal oil circulation pump.

StorageTank.description: Inventory vessel for the working fluid. In this substrate: Therminol VP1 buffer.

MaterialStream.description: Stream of mass (gas, liquid, or multi-phase) connecting unit ops. May be multi-phase with OVERALL/VAPOR/LIQUID per-phase tags (Phase 0a Q-2 phase handling).

EnergyStream.description: Heat duty (kW) as a flowsheet quantity. May be CONSTRAINED_BY a Constraint that bridges subsystems.

Recycle.description: DWSIM Recycle block — annotates a closed loop's tear stream and drives convergence iterations. Not physical equipment; appears in Phase 0a's owner_type as 'Recycle'.

Constraint.description: DWSIM Specification block enforcing an equality between two flowsheet quantities (typically EnergyStream values). Subsystem-less in Phase 0a (subsystem=None); sits at REFINERY level in the ontology since it can bridge subsystems. Two instances in this substrate: SPEC-02 (Reboiler Duty = -Reboiler Duty (2)) and SPEC-020 (Heating Duty = Reboiler Duty (2)).
